name: ondes-voxel
description: Ondes VOXEL - a C++ reimplementation of Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1
$comment-deps: Dependencies are added milestone by milestone, never up front. A first build on an 8 GB M2 compiles every port from source; see risk R5 in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. The 'client' feature is the physical barrier that keeps rendering out of the headless server: the linux-server-only CI job configures WITHOUT it, on an image that has no Vulkan SDK.
$comment-current: M0 needed formatting and DEFLATE; M1 adds asio for sockets; M5 adds simdjson for the JSON assets; M6 adds entt for entity storage. asio is header-only and template-heavy, so it stays inside .cpp files behind PIMPL — see risk R5. simdjson is here rather than under the 'client' feature because JSON is not a client concern: worldgen density functions, surface rules and datapacks are JSON too, and the headless server reads them. It is template-heavy, so it stays inside .cpp files. entt is the same story and then some: it is a PRIVATE_DEP of ov_entity and never appears in a public header, because a registry template in one would put its instantiation weight in every translation unit that spawns a zombie. mimalloc, xxhash, enkits and openssl arrive at the milestone that first uses them.

client.description: Rendering, windowing and audio. MUST NOT be required by ov_dedicated.
